request: Analyze GSE282166 for PMID 42168599 (The exercise hormone irisin has neuroprotective effects in a mouse model of multiple sclerosis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of FACS-sorted spinal cord nuclei (NeuN+ and NeuN- fractions), SMART-Seq HT, STAR + featureCounts (S9.16.p1, S9.18.p1, GEO data_processing)
final.sample_inclusion: EAE mice at peak of disease; AAV8-GFP n=3 vs AAV8-irisin-Flag n=3; NeuN+ and NeuN- nuclei from each animal (FIG4 b,c; FIG10)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of peripheral irisin overexpression (AAV8-irisin-Flag vs AAV8-GFP, injected on the day of EAE induction) on nuclear gene expression within each sorted spinal cord fraction at peak EAE. No exercise (running vs sedentary) arm was sequenced; exercise was studied only by histology/qPCR (FIG1, FIG5) and the running transcriptome comparison uses external snRNA-seq data (Sun et al., CRA007207; S9.19.p1).
planned_contrasts: NeuN+ nuclei: AAV8-irisin vs AAV8-GFP (S5.p1, FIG4b; paper: 1,017 DEGs)
NeuN- nuclei: AAV8-irisin vs AAV8-GFP (S5.p1, FIG4c; paper: 2 DEGs, Cd83 and Junb down)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 two-sided Wald test, BH correction, per fraction (S9.18.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S5.p1 and FIG4 describe the only sequencing experiment in GSE282166: sorted NeuN+/NeuN- nuclei from AAV8-GFP vs AAV8-irisin-Flag EAE mice, n=3 per arm. S9.18.p1 gives DESeq2 Wald + BH, |log2FC| >= 1 ('minimal log2(FC) of |1|') and FDR < 0.05. Exercise vs sedentary mice (FIG1, FIG5b,f) were only assessed by histology, clinical scores and qPCR; S9.19.p1 compares irisin DEGs with a public running snRNA-seq dataset not deposited here. The paper treats irisin as an exercise-induced hormone, but the sequenced estimand is an irisin-overexpression effect.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE282166 as the dataset generated here
metadata: 12 samples, spinal cord, NeuNneg/NeuNpos x GFP/IRISIN = 6 animals x 2 fractions, matching n=3 per arm in FIG4/FIG10
treatment_protocol_ch1 matches the AAV8-GFP / AAV8-Irisin-FLAG regimen

ownership.reasoning: DA.p1 deposits GSE282166; sample structure (3 GFP + 3 irisin animals, NeuN+/NeuN- each) matches FIG4 b,c and FIG10 legends.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (e.g. 12059-Neg-GFP) equal the metadata 'description' field for all 12 samples (inspect alignment_keys). Treatment taken from the description rather than characteristics_ch1.2.treatment, which carries a typo level 'IRISN' for one sample. The animal number links the two fractions of the same mouse.

matrix.reasoning: GSE282166_raw_counts.csv.gz: integer fraction 1.0, 49,315 Ensembl genes; GEO data_processing states featureCounts unique exon-mapped read counts. Matches the paper's DESeq2 input (S9.18.p1). The separate normalized_counts file is non-integer DESeq2-style normalized values and is not used.

candidates.reason_rejected: normalized non-integer values; DESeq2 needs raw counts

design.subject: animal
design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples: GSE282166 contains only AAV8-irisin-Flag vs AAV8-GFP EAE mice (sorted NeuN+/NeuN- spinal cord nuclei). No running/sedentary animals were sequenced; the paper's exercise-vs-sedentary experiments (FIG1, FIG5) are histology/qPCR only and its running transcriptome comparison uses external data (Sun et al., CRA007207). Irisin overexpression is a hormone-delivery intervention, not exercise, so the requested estimand (how exercise affects gene expression) is not identifiable from these data.
design.reasoning: The only identifiable comparison is irisin vs GFP within each nuclear fraction (paper: 1,017 NeuN+ DEGs, 2 NeuN- DEGs). The paper frames irisin as an exercise-induced hormone (ABS.p1, S1.p2) and S5.p3 reports ~10% overlap with running DEGs from an external dataset, but that makes the irisin effect at most a proposed mediator of exercise, not an exercise effect. Treating it as 'exercise' would misstate the estimand, so the case is refused at design rather than relabelled.

candidates.value: grp_IRISIN_vs_GFP within NeuNpos and NeuNneg (DESeq2, paper-aligned for the irisin estimand)
candidates.reason_rejected: answers the effect of AAV8 irisin overexpression, not of exercise; no exercise arm exists in GSE282166

discrepancies.paper: Voluntary wheel running vs sedentary EAE mice studied (FIG1, FIG5b,f) and running DEGs taken from external snRNA-seq (S9.19.p1)
discrepancies.data: GSE282166 holds only AAV8-GFP vs AAV8-irisin-Flag sorted nuclei; no running/sedentary samples
